hypotheses.hypothesis: Transport/service-admission or response-path delay exceeds the250ms owner child budget.
hypotheses.support: Four sampled callers wait in Conn.Call, and17 cumulative owner-service client timeouts appear in terminal cuts. Neither gives receiver phase or request identity.
hypotheses.prediction: A timeout with completed fast handler and late/missing reply enqueue/receive points beyond handler work; a timeout before handler start points to admission/transport.
hypotheses.controlled_seam: Real transport with one gated handler or bounded outbound reply scheduler; prove response demux needs no executor token.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact timed-out request shows timely enqueue, timely handler and timely decoded response before caller deadline; then inspect caller scheduling/correlation rather than these stages.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Owner Registry lock/scheduling or index traversal stalls a cold read after its client abandons it.
hypotheses.support: Every target visits32 session-ID shards with context-free RLock/scan. Started mixed-service handlers do not follow the250ms caller context. Registry writers contain no I/O. Sparse handler samples are fast and cannot prove this stall.
hypotheses.prediction: Holding a shard writer with a latch will stall an unrelated UID read that scans that shard; canceling its caller will not interrupt the current scan.
hypotheses.controlled_seam: Real Registry plus real service14 operation9/10 through transport; explicitly gate one writer and release it during finite cleanup.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact failed request has small measured lock waits and scan duration; reject Registry contention for that request.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Serial per-target or per-owner page work spends the shared page budget and retains the four recovery cohorts.
hypotheses.support: Owner10 iterates targets synchronously; origin iterates eligible owners in sorted order; no per-UID physical-Slot metadata work exists. Four cohorts are sampled executing; quota waits do not identify which key/byte/cohort dimension bound.
hypotheses.prediction: Gate the first independent target/owner and the later one cannot complete through that envelope until the gate releases, although an independently admitted envelope can progress.
hypotheses.controlled_seam: Two fenced target groups and real owner batch adapter; bounded controlled local workload rather than broad performance retuning.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact failed page is small and all target/owner work completes within budget; serialization is then not its cause.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Membership/route/boot changes or application-level rejection repeatedly prevent complete proof despite transport handler ok.
hypotheses.support: Before/after membership, target and boot validation can reject a complete transport reply; current metrics combine all owner operations and map encoded application errors to transport ok. No retained evidence establishes such a change.
hypotheses.prediction: A controlled exact fence/boot change must reject only affected proof and consume only existing retry policy; a current stable page must install.
hypotheses.controlled_seam: Existing generation/fence cases plus a bounded receiver-stage correlation record; no additional retry or timeout.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact request has stable full fences/boot/membership and successful Directory installation before deadline; reject this route for that sample.
